definition: why how much I have riding on someone never moves their grade

settled:
Cloudflare's B is the same B whether one thing of mine runs on it or four do.

The letter is about them. How much I have riding on them is about me, and about the shape of my own graph.

So the two get weighed in different places. The grade says how far I trust them. How concentrated I am multiplies what a failure of theirs would cost, which is what orders my queue rather than what sets the letter.

Mixing the two would let a bad grade hide behind small exposure, and a good one look dangerous because I leaned on it hard.

title: How Much Of Me Is On One Provider
